name: Niagara Drift
author: Evan Yerburgh
tagline: A drone synth for the FM-1
description: Two drones that breathe and drift on their own, shaped by hand: from hypnotic and blissful to harsh, beating and self-oscillating. Presets and macros for instant ambient textures, and deep controls to pilot them into outer space.
credits: Built from FoMni by Charles Vestal and Felucca's platform by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments), with fm1-base's screen reader and flash checks.
